semantic_slots.target: Arbitrary stored real N-by-M matrices; literal angle/row/elimination refinements and legal fused adjacent sweep with chronological action, log length and exact emission. All 60 named declarations plus anonymous Monad instance compared, including zero, same-index and empty-carrier boundaries; no EXCESS premise.
semantic_slots.normalization: No normalized state, orthogonal matrix, rank, determinant, square shape or nonzero-pivot hypothesis. Pair norm is internal scalar data; literal general same-index updates are not orthogonal elimination.
semantic_slots.registers: Nested N rows of M stored reals. Ordered adjacent pairs are visited bottom-to-top; each tail uses the updated matrix. General rotation writes j then i with first-branch/last-write priority, including i=j. Head log entry acts first. Sweep retains col:Fin M and lo+count<N even at zero; no qubit bit-order claim.
semantic_slots.oracles: No coherent quantum oracle. collect/materialize take unrestricted Run-valued callback data and retain supplied callback counters; pure and callbacks may hide uncharged work. Stored reads and row-reference copies are distinct from arbitrary entry evaluation.
semantic_slots.ancillas_phases: No quantum ancilla, garbage-cleanup or phase-equivalence contract. Exact real angle signs and half-angle convention match splitAngle/eval and rotateRows. ExactAngle is literal syntax, not a quotient or uniquely chosen representative.
semantic_slots.error_success: Exact deterministic equalities and componentwise natural-counter inequalities; no approximation tolerance, numerical stability, probabilistic success or postselection promise. Zero pairs are not pruned. Source/formal agreement does not certify finite numerical execution.
semantic_slots.resources: Stipulated eight-counter exact-real annotation model in order field,sqrt,angle,trig,compare,read,write,emit. Per-step bound (6M+8,1,1,2,2,10M+2N+6,6M+2N,1); fused sweep bound count times this vector and exact count emits. Materialization adds supplied callback costs plus (NM+N)(2 read+2 write) only when explicitly composed. No evaluator/finite-bit runtime, memory-space, hardware/gate or polynomial-in-qubits bound.
